stage.note: This is Tribes, Inc.'s (the parent company's) only priced round; Zipbox is one of Tribes' products (alongside Chief and the retired Tape Room), not a separately funded entity.

last_round.quote: We started in 2021 with a social wallet, and closed a $3.3M pre-seed in October 2022 from Kindred Ventures, South Park Commons, Script Capital and the Solana Foundation.

note: Zipbox (zipbox.ai) is one of several products built by Tribes, Inc. (founded 2021, California), a small crypto/AI-agent product studio with alumni from Coinbase, Apple, Twitter and Lyft. Tribes raised a $3.3M pre-seed in October 2022 (Kindred Ventures, South Park Commons, Script Capital, Solana Foundation) — the funding covers the whole company, not Zipbox specifically; Tribes' other products are Chief (open source, on GitHub) and Tape Room (a crypto trading terminal, now retired). No YC or other accelerator affiliation found. No revenue/ARR figures published for either Tribes or Zipbox.
